title: Customer Service Specialist
description: A fantastic opportunity has arisen for this training organisation with offices in Bradford. Working as a Customer Service Specialist, the successful candidate will deal with customer queries across several mediums to manage and resolve customer issues. Acting as the first point of contact, the Customer Service Specialist will work to high levels of customer service, ensuring that lasting relationships continue to flourish. A varied role that would be perfect for a candidate with a minimum of 12 months experience within customer care and administration, duties are varied but will include; - Manage shared email inboxes - Deal with all customer enquiries - Prepare customer quotations - Accurate and timely input/update on CRM - Ensure all customer interactions are handled efficiently - Provide outstanding customer care This is an exciting opportunity for an engaging, customer focussed advisor to join this supportive and fun team. This is a fully office-based role with some flexible after your probationary period, hours of work are 9-5 Monday - Friday. The successful candidate will have; - Minimum of 12 months customer relations and administration experience - Customer-focused with a professional and friendly manner - Highly organised - Can demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills - Confident using technology - Proactive, flexible approach with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team If you hold the above skills and experiences, please submit your CV for review. Please note if you have not heard from us within 7 days, your application has been unsuccessful.

title: Customer Service Administrator
description: Job Title: Customer Service Administrator Location: Huddersfield (on-site) Salary: 26,125 basic + bonus and shift allowance (up to 28,195) Job Type: Full-time 37.5 hours per week Shift Pattern: 4 on 4 off Rotating early and lates - 2x shifts are earlies (5:30am to 4:30pm) and 2x lates (10am to 9pm) Loom Talent is recruiting a Customer Service Administrator for a specialist transport and logistics business. You'll be based at their Huddersfield control centre, supporting the planning, dispatch and resource teams. What you'll be doing: - Handling customer queries by phone, email and SMS, investigating and resolving complaints and keeping a clear record of how each one was resolved - Using the planning and CRM systems to find information, input data and reconcile products loaded against products delivered, investigating any discrepancies - Supporting the Resource Managers with stakeholder communications and maintaining the resource system and working with the Control Centre analyst team on management information - Reviewing agency drivers' hours submissions and once authorised, raising, sending and tracking purchase orders, including for driver medicals, random drug and alcohol tests and external training providers - Planning periodic driver training (annual refreshers, defensive driving) and arranging ADR renewals, keeping the driver capability matrix up to date - Providing general admin support, such as collating overtime availability across locations and producing summary plans for field managers and Driver Training Instructors What we're looking for: - A customer service and admin background - High attention to detail - Planning, ATOSS or PO systems experience is a bonus Hours: - 2x shifts are earlies (5:30am to 4:30pm) and 2x lates (10am to 9pm) - 37.5 hours per week on either pattern To apply, or for a confidential conversation, contact Kieran Hayes at Loom Talent, (url removed).
